canonical_hash_rule: For each spec, remove hidden_spec_sha256 and SHA-256 the UTF-8 canonical JSON with sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=false.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One independently moving revolute panel.

measurable_constraints.description: Hinge origin is within 0.05 asset diagonals of a vertical door edge.
Closed door projection covers at least 75 percent of the front opening.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One independently moving prismatic component.

measurable_constraints.description: Closed drawer is at least 95 percent laterally contained by the body.
Drawer travel is at least 45 percent of drawer depth.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One independently moving lid.

measurable_constraints.description: Hinge origin is within 0.05 asset diagonals of the lid rear edge.
Lid-to-box XY footprint area ratio is between 0.85 and 1.10.

specs.difficulty_rationale: A symmetric pair of independently moving panels.

measurable_constraints.description: Left-right door mesh-area relative difference is at most 15 percent.
Closed doors jointly cover at least 85 percent of the front opening.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Two opposed folding panels must align in the deployed state.

measurable_constraints.description: Left-right leaf bounding-box dimension difference is at most 10 percent.
Deployed top-surface height span is at most 0.02 asset diagonals.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Three repeated prismatic components require semantic and geometric consistency.

measurable_constraints.description: Drawer-front height coefficient of variation is at most 0.15.
Closed drawer pairwise intersection volume is at most 0.001 of asset volume.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Mixed revolute and prismatic branches must form a usable deployed surface.

measurable_constraints.description: Deployed writing-panel normal is within 10 degrees of +Z.
Deployed support endpoints lie below opposite outer thirds of the panel.

specs.difficulty_rationale: A large primary panel and two secondary supports require coordinated deployment.

measurable_constraints.description: Deployed bed-plane normal is within 10 degrees of +Z.
Deployed leg endpoint heights differ by at most 0.02 asset diagonals.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Seven moving components form multiple independent branches.

measurable_constraints.description: Closed drawer pairwise intersection volume is at most 0.001 of asset volume.
Deployed tray top heights differ by at most 0.03 asset diagonals.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One large revolute leaf with an unambiguous vertical hinge.

measurable_constraints.description: Hinge origin is within 0.04 asset diagonals of a vertical door edge.
Door height-to-width ratio is at least 1.60.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One constrained vertical prismatic motion.

measurable_constraints.description: Sash XY containment in the frame is at least 90 percent throughout travel.
Sash travel is between 35 and 80 percent of sash height.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One upward-opening panel.

measurable_constraints.description: Hinge origin is within 0.05 asset diagonals of the lid rear edge.
Closed lid projection covers at least 90 percent of the curb opening.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Two opposed large leaves must close symmetrically.

measurable_constraints.description: Left-right gate-leaf area relative difference is at most 10 percent.
Closed center gap is at most 5 percent of total gate width.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Two opposed framed panes require correct containment.

measurable_constraints.description: Each pane projection is at least 95 percent contained by its sash.
Left-right sash dimension difference is at most 10 percent.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Mixed extension and folding branches must remain symmetric.

measurable_constraints.description: Front-bar long axis is within 5 degrees of horizontal.
Left-right support-arm length difference is at most 10 percent.

specs.difficulty_rationale: A coupled serial panel chain must close a large opening.

measurable_constraints.description: Upper-lower panel width difference is at most 5 percent.
Closed panels jointly cover at least 90 percent of the frame opening.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Four serial panels use alternating hinge directions.

measurable_constraints.description: Panel-height coefficient of variation is at most 0.05.
Maximum closed adjacent-panel edge gap is at most 0.03 asset diagonals.

specs.difficulty_rationale: A central continuous rotor and two independent emergency branches coexist.

measurable_constraints.description: Four rotor wings are spaced at 90 degrees plus or minus 8 degrees.
Rotor axis is within 0.03 asset diagonals of the frame-opening center.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One pivot relates two clearly defined rigid halves.

measurable_constraints.description: Pivot lies inside the overlap region of the two half meshes.
Opening the joint increases jaw-tip separation by at least 0.02 m.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One prismatic jaw and one coaxial screw.

measurable_constraints.description: Opposing jaw faces are parallel within 5 degrees.
Jaw travel is normal to the jaw faces within 10 degrees.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One precision linear degree of freedom plus a local wheel.

measurable_constraints.description: Opposing measurement faces are parallel within 3 degrees.
Slider axis aligns with the beam long axis within 5 degrees.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Independent rotary input and vertical output require functional alignment.

measurable_constraints.description: Ram centerline projects within 0.05 asset diagonals of the table center.
Ram travel is normal to the table within 5 degrees.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Three rotary components use different axes.

measurable_constraints.description: Crank and spindle axes are perpendicular within 10 degrees.
Chuck and spindle axes are within 0.02 asset diagonals of coaxial.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Three nested axes implement indexing, plunge, and cutting.

measurable_constraints.description: Blade center is above the turntable in the neutral pose.
Blade-center distance from arm pivot is between 0.15 and 0.55 asset diagonals.

specs.difficulty_rationale: A tree representation must approximate a symmetric closed-loop mechanism.

measurable_constraints.description: Free upper-arm endpoint remains within 0.04 asset diagonals of its saddle pin.
Saddle center lateral drift is at most 0.05 asset diagonals over travel.

specs.difficulty_rationale: A near-closed linkage and adjustable end effector require consistent geometry.

measurable_constraints.description: Closed coupler endpoint is within 0.04 asset diagonals of the arm linkage pin.
Pressure-pad projection lies inside the base work region.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Four nested degrees of freedom require coaxiality and workspace alignment.

measurable_constraints.description: Spindle-axis offset from the column is between 0.15 and 0.45 asset diagonals.
Spindle axis projects inside the table footprint in the neutral pose.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One extension and a symmetric wheel pair.

measurable_constraints.description: Left-right wheel radius difference is at most 5 percent.
Extended handle rises at least 0.15 asset diagonals above the body.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Four repeated continuous joints share a common rolling axis.

measurable_constraints.description: Wheel-radius coefficient of variation is at most 0.05.
Wheel lowest-point height span is at most 0.02 asset diagonals.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One mirrored rolling pair attached to a simple frame.

measurable_constraints.description: Wheel-center mirror error is at most 0.03 asset diagonals.
Toe-plate bottom is within 0.03 asset diagonals of wheel-bottom height.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Steering, folding, and wheel axes interact.

measurable_constraints.description: Front and rear rolling axes are parallel within 5 degrees.
Deployed handlebar rises at least 0.35 asset diagonals above the deck.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Steering and multiple drive-related rotary axes coexist.

measurable_constraints.description: Rear wheel-center mirror error is at most 0.03 asset diagonals.
Front-wheel radius is at least the mean rear-wheel radius.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Nested caster joints and symmetric folding branches increase topology.

measurable_constraints.description: Drive-wheel radius difference is at most 5 percent.
All wheel lowest-point heights span at most 0.04 asset diagonals.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Multiple folding branches and nested caster axes must remain symmetric.

measurable_constraints.description: Deployed wheel lowest-point heights span at most 0.04 asset diagonals.
Left-right side-frame dimension difference is at most 10 percent.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Vehicle articulation and an independent cargo branch share one structure.

measurable_constraints.description: Front-rear wheel-radius difference is at most 15 percent.
Cargo-box center lies longitudinally between the two wheel axes.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Steering, handle pitch, rolling, and lifting create nested mixed joints.

measurable_constraints.description: The two forks are parallel within 3 degrees.
Fork-carriage travel is vertical within 3 degrees.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One bounded rotary control about the valve stem.

measurable_constraints.description: Rotor axis is within 0.03 asset diagonals of the valve body centerline.
Lever long axis is perpendicular to the rotor axis within 10 degrees.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One internal quarter-turn disc requires clear coaxial placement.

measurable_constraints.description: Disc center is within 0.03 asset diagonals of the duct center.
Disc diameter is between 85 and 99 percent of duct inner diameter.

specs.difficulty_rationale: A primary lid and local latch form a short serial chain.

measurable_constraints.description: Closed cover projection covers at least 90 percent of the opening.
Latch lies in the half of the cover opposite the hinge.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Rotary input and linear output require plausible alignment.

measurable_constraints.description: Plunger is coaxial with the cylinder within 0.02 asset diagonals.
Handle pivot is within 0.15 asset diagonals of the cylinder top.

specs.difficulty_rationale: A revolute arm carries a continuous pulley joint.

measurable_constraints.description: Pulley-center distance from arm pivot is between 0.15 and 0.55 asset diagonals.
Pulley axis is normal to the arm sweep plane within 10 degrees.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Continuous rotation, a locking translation, and a lever coexist.

measurable_constraints.description: Platen and base axes are within 0.02 asset diagonals of coaxial.
Index-pin radius is between 35 and 90 percent of platen radius.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Four nested mixed joints form a long serial work chain.

measurable_constraints.description: Zero-extension cross-section is at least 90 percent contained by the boom.
Hook block remains below the boom tip throughout hoist travel.

specs.difficulty_rationale: A wrist axis and symmetric mimic jaws require coupling and precision.

measurable_constraints.description: Jaw-center mirror error is at most 0.02 asset diagonals.
Opposing finger contact faces are parallel within 3 degrees.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Independent vertical axes and a rotary control must share one work center.

measurable_constraints.description: Ram axis projects within 0.05 asset diagonals of the bed center.
Bed remains between the two frame columns throughout travel.

specs.difficulty_rationale: A short three-joint serial chain has clear endpoint semantics.

measurable_constraints.description: Every arm hinge lies within 0.08 asset diagonals of incident-link endpoints.
Lamp head is a terminal link of the articulated chain.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Three orthogonal rotary functions form a compact chain.

measurable_constraints.description: Blade axis aligns with the fan-head forward normal within 5 degrees.
Blade center is within 0.03 asset diagonals of the head center.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Two nested panels share a rear hinge region.

measurable_constraints.description: Seat and lid hinge axes are within 0.02 asset diagonals of collinear.
Seat-to-lid XY footprint area ratio is between 0.60 and 1.05.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Crossed supports create a near-closed folding arrangement.

measurable_constraints.description: Four deployed foot heights span at most 0.04 asset diagonals.
Deployed board normal is within 8 degrees of +Z.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Two human-interface panels move around distinct pivots.

measurable_constraints.description: Backrest pivot is within 0.08 asset diagonals of the seat rear edge.
Deployed footrest center lies in front of the seat center.

specs.difficulty_rationale: A telescoping column carries a tilting surface with symmetric local joints.

measurable_constraints.description: Desk center remains within 0.12 asset diagonals of the column axis.
Page-retainer mirror error is at most 0.03 asset diagonals.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Four degrees of freedom form a continuous load-bearing surface.

measurable_constraints.description: Neutral support-surface heights span at most 0.02 asset diagonals.
Section hinges lie within 0.04 asset diagonals of corresponding mesh seams.

specs.difficulty_rationale: One long translation and three human-interface rotations share a narrow frame.

measurable_constraints.description: Seat-travel axis aligns with the rail long axis within 5 degrees.
Footplate-center mirror error is at most 0.03 asset diagonals.

specs.difficulty_rationale: Three non-collinear support joints combine with height, pan, and tilt.

measurable_constraints.description: Deployed foot azimuth spacing is 120 degrees plus or minus 15 degrees.
Deployed foot heights span at most 0.03 asset diagonals.
